MODEL PROVENANCE

Real geometry. A virtual rehearsal.

The chassis and eight caster parts come from I2RT’s official Linear Bot model, exported from Onshape. The lift and arms are omitted. The camera mast is an illustrative rig.

SourceI2RT Robotics / linearbot
Revision8c1b3ab · MIT license
Coordinate frameX forward · Y left · Z up
Wheel radius / caster trail50 mm / 20 mm

This preview integrates body velocity and I2RT’s caster kinematics. Floor contact, wheel slip, motor dynamics, payload stability, and real stopping distance are not simulated. Stage clearance checks are approximate. Camera height and lenses are planning assumptions.
